command.name: security key-manager external aws check
command.description: This command displays the Amazon Web Service (AWS) Key Management Service (KMS) status.

parameter.name: node
parameter.description: If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the AWS KMS status for the given node.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the AWS KMS status for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: category
parameter.description:
If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the AWS KMS status for the given category.
Category Description -------- ----------- service_reachability Cloud KMS Reachability ekmip_server Embedded KMIP Server Reachability kms_wrapped_key_status Status of KMS Wrapped Keys On Cluster

parameter.name: status
parameter.description:
If this parameter is specified then the command displays only the AWS KMS status entries matching the given status.
OK FAILED UNKNOWN

parameter.name: detail
parameter.description: This field displays a detailed status message, if available.

example.p: The example below displays the status of all components of all AWS KMS instances configured on node vsim1.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external aws check -node vsim1 Vserver: vs1 Node: vsim1
Category: service_reachability Status: OK
Category: ekmip_server Status: OK
Category: kms_wrapped_key_status Status: OK
